feature_contracts.scope: static interface binding; behavioral results are verified separately

requirements.requirement: Expose a real firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, valid, write-enable, ready, and error semantics.
Implement register decode for all declared software-visible registers and fields in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.register_contract.
Package and emit model-request transport traffic and capture model-response traffic using the mandated direction contract.
Evaluate transparent reference and physics-based surrogate outputs and compare them under bounded operating conditions.
Track stale-data age, model-response timeout, and control-loop fault conditions.
Generate bounded actuator commands only when validated; otherwise deassert validity and latch faults.
Provide MMIO access to bulk history/payload storage through technology-neutral memory wrappers.
Never create fallback commands or substitute controllers on fault conditions.
All firmware-visible registers listed in the register_contract must be decoded by the top-level MMIO engine and must not be described as inaccessible internal state.
MMIO writes update only declared writable fields; MMIO reads return the latest committed field values and status fields.
The model request output is valid only when a request packet is fully formed and the request channel is selected by control logic.
The model response ready output may be asserted only when the top is able to accept a response beat and must follow the transport handshake contract.

If a model response is stale, malformed, or fails validation against the transparent reference or safety envelope, actuator_cmd_valid shall be deasserted and fault_latched shall assert or remain asserted.
If response timeout or staleness exceeds configured limits, actuator_cmd_valid shall be deasserted and fault_latched shall assert or remain asserted.
Actuator command outputs shall remain bounded to the configured envelope; invalid conditions inhibit validity rather than substituting a fallback command.
Do not implement any fallback command, fallback register, fallback status, fallback controller, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior.
Bulk storage is technology-neutral and memory-macro-backed; it is not flattened into register arrays in the digital contract.

On reset assertion, internal state, pending MMIO transaction state, model transaction state, stale/timeout counters, and queued actuator request state reset to a known idle condition. Actuator command validity is deasserted, status_valid is
Expose firmware-readable and firmware-writable configuration fields.
Provide explicit semantic outputs that other modules can consume without hidden derivation.
Bridge MMIO transaction semantics into controller configuration and storage address windows.
Reflect controller status and latched fault visibility to firmware.
Every register in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.register_contract must be represented by explicit decode logic and must map to one or more declared output fields.
No inaccessible internal state may be described as software-visible.
Fault-clear is a one-cycle semantic output to the controller and does not itself clear a fault without controller acknowledgement semantics.
MMIO errors must be reported on invalid addresses, malformed accesses, or unsupported field writes.
Readback must be deterministic and aligned to the declared register map.

All output configuration fields reset to a safe disabled or default state. Read data and ready/error outputs return idle-safe values as defined by the MMIO transaction contract. The module does not assert any controller command; it only dec
Emit model-request valid/data outputs and receive model-request ready as input.
Receive model-response valid/data inputs and emit model-response ready as output.
Stage request payload fields from controller-prepared semantic inputs.
Capture response payloads for validation and diagnostic use.
Expose transport-busy and transport-valid indicators to the controller.
Detect response staleness relative to the configured timing policy.
The request path must drive valid/data outputs only from explicit semantic pack inputs and control state.
The response path must only consume valid/data inputs and must not be used to drive request-side transport outputs.
Stale response detection must assert response_stale when the accepted response exceeds configured freshness limits.
Busy indication must reflect actual in-flight transaction state, not a fabricated fallback state.
Transport logic may coexist with the MMIO control plane, but it cannot replace the MMIO control plane.

Transport handshake outputs and internal packet staging reset to idle. No request is emitted until enabled and a valid packet is available. Response-ready follows safe acceptance policy after reset release. No fallback payload is generated.
Evaluate the surrogate and reference outputs for active-aerodynamic control.
Provide explicit surrogate and reference command candidates for downstream comparison.
Flag invalid, stale, or out-of-envelope responses through validation outputs.
Respect configured actuator bounds and operating mode selection.
Keep the transparent reference separate from any bypass or fallback path.
Validation must compare surrogate-derived and transparent reference commands within configured bounds and freshness policy.
If response_stale is asserted, validation_valid must deassert and validation_error must assert or remain asserted.
No fallback command may be generated when validation fails; only invalidation and fault propagation are allowed.
Surrogate and reference outputs must be explicitly distinct semantic signals.
Operating modes select which validated candidate is eligible for downstream bounded actuation, but not a substitute controller.

All command candidates and validation outputs reset invalid or zeroed as appropriate to the safe inactive state. No actuator-valid output is produced from reset. The module does not invent a substitute command when response data are unavail
Bound actuator outputs to configured tilt and deflection limits.
Deassert actuator validity on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions.
Latch faults until firmware clears them through the explicit clear-fault semantic.
Provide status and fault outputs to the MMIO block for software observation.
Never substitute a fallback command or alternate controller output.
Final outputs must be bounded and only valid when validation has succeeded and no fault conditions are active.
If validation_error is asserted or if any stale/timeout indicator is active, actuator_cmd_valid shall deassert.
The module may hold the last safe bounded value internally, but it must not assert validity without a fresh accepted command.
Fault status must be latched for firmware handling and reflected back through status outputs.

All actuator outputs deassert validity and reset to safe encoded values. Fault latch is cleared only to the explicit reset baseline defined by the architecture and must not produce a command. No fallback command is produced on reset.
Expose read data to firmware-facing logic and controller analytics.
Maintain technology-neutral memory mapping suitable for FPGA block RAM inference or binding.
Report simple busy indicators to prevent unsafe concurrent access.
Implement bulk storage as an inferred memory rather than a flattened bank of scalar registers.
Return stored read data through the declared functional output port.
Reads return data from the declared memory macros via the technology-neutral wrapper contract.
Busy outputs only reflect access sequencing and do not substitute for control or fault status.
The history/payload memory interface is separate from actuator control and cannot override fault handling.
Infer one synthesizable unpacked memory array with synchronous access so FPGA tools can map it to block RAM.

Memory access control resets to idle. No data is synthesized as a fallback; stored memory contents remain implementation-defined unless written by firmware or controller flow. For inferred storage on reset, hold the declared read-data outpu

module adaptive_aero_control_top (
    input         clk,
    input         reset_n,
    input  [15:0] mmio_addr,
    input  [31:0] mmio_wdata,
    input         mmio_valid,
    input         mmio_we,
    output [31:0] mmio_rdata,
    output        mmio_ready,
    output        mmio_error,
    input         model_req_ready,
    output        model_req_valid,
    output [63:0] model_req_data,
    input         model_rsp_valid,
    input  [127:0] model_rsp_data,
    output        model_rsp_ready,
    output        actuator_cmd_valid,
    output [7:0] actuator_cmd_tilt,
    output [7:0] actuator_cmd_deflection,
    output [1:0] actuator_cmd_mode,
    output        fault_latched,
    output        status_valid,
    output [7:0] status_code
);
wire cfg_enable;
wire cfg_surrogate_select;
wire [15:0] cfg_timeout_cycles;
wire [15:0] cfg_stale_limit_cycles;
wire [7:0] cfg_tilt_limit;
wire [7:0] cfg_deflection_limit;
wire [1:0] cfg_mode_select;
wire cfg_clear_fault;
wire [8:0] cfg_history_base;
wire [7:0] cfg_payload_base;
wire status_fault_latched;
wire status_model_busy;
wire status_model_valid;
wire status_timeout_active;
wire status_stale_active;
wire [7:0] status_last_response_code;
wire [31:0] pack_vehicle_state;
wire [15:0] pack_wind_state;
wire [15:0] pack_reference_state;
wire response_valid;
wire [127:0] response_data;
wire response_stale;
wire [7:0] surrogate_tilt_cmd;
wire [7:0] surrogate_deflection_cmd;
wire [7:0] reference_tilt_cmd;
wire [7:0] reference_deflection_cmd;
wire validation_valid;
wire validation_error;
wire [7:0] validation_delta_code;
wire history_busy;
wire payload_busy;
adaptive_aero_mmio_csr u_mmio_csr (
    .clk(clk),
    .reset_n(reset_n),
    .mmio_addr(mmio_addr),
    .mmio_wdata(mmio_wdata),
    .mmio_valid(mmio_valid),
    .mmio_we(mmio_we),
    .mmio_rdata(mmio_rdata),
    .mmio_ready(mmio_ready),
    .mmio_error(mmio_error),
    .cfg_enable(cfg_enable),
    .cfg_surrogate_select(cfg_surrogate_select),
    .cfg_timeout_cycles(cfg_timeout_cycles),
    .cfg_stale_limit_cycles(cfg_stale_limit_cycles),
    .cfg_tilt_limit(cfg_tilt_limit),
    .cfg_deflection_limit(cfg_deflection_limit),
    .cfg_mode_select(cfg_mode_select),
    .cfg_clear_fault(cfg_clear_fault),
    .cfg_history_base(cfg_history_base),
    .cfg_payload_base(cfg_payload_base),
    .status_fault_latched(status_fault_latched),
    .status_model_busy(status_model_busy),
    .status_model_valid(status_model_valid),
    .status_timeout_active(status_timeout_active),
    .status_stale_active(status_stale_active),
    .status_last_response_code(status_last_response_code),
    .status_valid(status_valid)
);

adaptive_aero_transport u_transport (
    .clk(clk),
    .reset_n(reset_n),
    .cfg_enable(cfg_enable),
    .cfg_surrogate_select(cfg_surrogate_select),
    .model_req_ready(model_req_ready),
    .model_req_valid(model_req_valid),
    .model_req_data(model_req_data),
    .model_rsp_valid(model_rsp_valid),
    .model_rsp_data(model_rsp_data),
    .model_rsp_ready(model_rsp_ready),
    .pack_vehicle_state(pack_vehicle_state),
    .pack_wind_state(pack_wind_state),

adaptive_aero_surrogate_reference u_surrogate_reference (

    .response_data(response_data),
    .response_stale(response_stale),
    .pack_vehicle_state(pack_vehicle_state),
    .pack_wind_state(pack_wind_state),
    .pack_reference_state(pack_reference_state),
    .surrogate_tilt_cmd(surrogate_tilt_cmd),

    .validation_error(validation_error),

adaptive_aero_safety_bounding u_safety (
    .clk(clk),
    .reset_n(reset_n),
    .cfg_enable(cfg_enable),
    .cfg_clear_fault(cfg_clear_fault),
    .cfg_tilt_limit(cfg_tilt_limit),
    .cfg_deflection_limit(cfg_deflection_limit),
    .validation_valid(validation_valid),
    .validation_error(validation_error),
    .validation_delta_code(validation_delta_code),
    .surrogate_tilt_cmd(surrogate_tilt_cmd),
    .surrogate_deflection_cmd(surrogate_deflection_cmd),
    .reference_tilt_cmd(reference_tilt_cmd),
    .reference_deflection_cmd(reference_deflection_cmd),
    .actuator_cmd_valid(actuator_cmd_valid),
    .actuator_cmd_tilt(actuator_cmd_tilt),
    .actuator_cmd_deflection(actuator_cmd_deflection),
    .actuator_cmd_mode(actuator_cmd_mode),
    .fault_latched(fault_latched),
    .status_valid(status_valid),
    .status_code(status_code),
    .status_fault_latched(status_fault_latched),
    .status_timeout_active(status_timeout_active),
    .status_stale_active(status_stale_active)
);

adaptive_aero_history_store u_history_store (
    .clk(clk),
    .reset_n(reset_n),
    .cfg_history_base(cfg_history_base),
    .cfg_payload_base(cfg_payload_base),
    .history_busy(history_busy),
    .payload_busy(payload_busy)
);

assign status_model_valid = response_valid;
assign status_last_response_code = status_code;

endmodule

module adaptive_aero_mmio_csr (
    input         clk,
    input         reset_n,
    input  [15:0] mmio_addr,
    input  [31:0] mmio_wdata,
    input         mmio_valid,
    input         mmio_we,
    output reg [31:0] mmio_rdata,
    output reg        mmio_ready,
    output reg        mmio_error,
    output reg        cfg_enable,
    output reg        cfg_surrogate_select,
    output reg [15:0] cfg_timeout_cycles,
    output reg [15:0] cfg_stale_limit_cycles,
    output reg [7:0] cfg_tilt_limit,
    output reg [7:0] cfg_deflection_limit,
    output reg [1:0] cfg_mode_select,
    output reg        cfg_clear_fault,
    output reg [8:0] cfg_history_base,
    output reg [7:0] cfg_payload_base,
    input             status_fault_latched,
    input             status_model_busy,
    input             status_model_valid,
    input             status_timeout_active,
    input             status_stale_active,
    input      [7:0] status_last_response_code,
    input             status_valid
);

always @(*) begin
    mmio_error = 1'b0;
    case (mmio_addr)
        16'h0000: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0004: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0008: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h000C: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0010: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0014: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0018: begin
            if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            end
        end
        16'h0020: begin
        end
        16'h0024: begin
        end
        16'h0028: begin
        end
        default: begin
            mmio_error = 1'b1;
        end
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
        cfg_enable <= 1'b0;
        cfg_surrogate_select <= 1'b0;
        cfg_timeout_cycles <= 16'd1000;
        cfg_stale_limit_cycles <= 16'd300;
        cfg_tilt_limit <= 8'd32;
        cfg_deflection_limit <= 8'd32;
        cfg_mode_select <= 2'b00;
        mmio_ready <= 1'b1;
        cfg_clear_fault <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        mmio_ready <= 1'b1;
        cfg_clear_fault <= 1'b0;
        if (mmio_valid && mmio_we) begin
            case (mmio_addr)
                16'h0000: begin
                    cfg_enable <= mmio_wdata[0];
                    cfg_surrogate_select <= mmio_wdata[1];
                    cfg_mode_select <= mmio_wdata[3:2];
                end
                16'h0004: cfg_timeout_cycles <= mmio_wdata[15:0];
                16'h0008: cfg_stale_limit_cycles <= mmio_wdata[15:0];
                16'h000C: cfg_tilt_limit <= mmio_wdata[7:0];
                16'h0010: cfg_deflection_limit <= mmio_wdata[7:0];
                16'h0014: cfg_history_base <= mmio_wdata[8:0];
                16'h0018: cfg_payload_base <= mmio_wdata[7:0];
                default: begin
                end
            endcase
        end
        if (mmio_valid && !mmio_we) begin
            case (mmio_addr)
                16'h0000: mmio_rdata <= {27'h0000000, 1'b0, cfg_mode_select, cfg_surrogate_select, cfg_enable};
                16'h0004: mmio_rdata <= {16'h0000, cfg_timeout_cycles};
                16'h0008: mmio_rdata <= {16'h0000, cfg_stale_limit_cycles};
                16'h000C: mmio_rdata <= {24'h000000, cfg_tilt_limit};
                16'h0010: mmio_rdata <= {24'h000000, cfg_deflection_limit};
                16'h0014: mmio_rdata <= {23'h000000, cfg_history_base};
                16'h0018: mmio_rdata <= {24'h000000, cfg_payload_base};
                16'h0020: mmio_rdata <= {16'h0000, status_last_response_code, 2'b00, status_stale_active, status_timeout_active, status_model_valid, status_model_busy, status_fault_latched, status_valid};
                16'h0024: mmio_rdata <= {20'b0, cfg_timeout_cycles[7:0], cfg_enable, cfg_surrogate_select, cfg_mode_select};
                16'h0028: mmio_rdata <= {24'h000000, cfg_payload_base};
                default: mmio_rdata <= 32'h00000000;
            endcase
        end
        if (mmio_valid && mmio_we && mmio_addr == 16'h0000 && mmio_wdata[4]) begin
            cfg_clear_fault <= 1'b1;
        end
    end
end

endmodule
